nights.title: Julia Wolf
nights.name: Julia Wolf
nights.extract: Julia Jade Capello, known professionally as Julia Wolf, is an American singer. Known for her ethereal vocals and self-produced alt-pop sound, she blends elements of indie pop, alternative rock, and R&B. Capello gained early attention on TikTok before releasing her debut EP Girls in Purgatory (2021) and her studio albums Good Thing We Stayed (2023) and Pressure (2025).

en.who: Julia Wolf is an American singer known for ethereal vocals and a self-produced alt-pop sound. She blends indie pop, alternative rock and R&B, and first drew attention on TikTok.

tr.who: Julia Wolf, etherik vokalleri ve kendi prodüksiyonu alt-pop sesiyle bilinen Amerikalı bir şarkıcıdır. Indie pop, alternatif rock ve R&B öğelerini harmanlar; ilk olarak TikTok'ta dikkat çekti.
facts: İlk EP'si Girls in Purgatory (2021), TikTok'taki erken ilginin ardından çıktı.
Stüdyo albümleri Good Thing We Stayed (2023) ve Pressure (2025)'tir.
